title: Customer complaints
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What makes a customer complaint reasonable rather than simply demanding?
Should companies apologise even when they believe they did nothing wrong?
Which matters more after a mistake: a refund, an apology, or a quick solution?
Have online reviews made companies more accountable or made customers too powerful?
If you managed a company, how would you train employees to handle an angry customer?
